# systeam_team (Resource)

Manages a team: an org-scoped grouping used for ownership and routing. Projects, on-call schedules, escalation policies and integration keys can belong to a team.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The team's display name.
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this team belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the team.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier. Generated from the name when omitted; cannot be changed afterwards.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the team.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the team is active.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of members in the team.
